text: ‘Globalisation is leading to increased cultural diversity.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Dependency theory provides the best explanation of global inequality.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Media content is controlled primarily by governments.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The hypodermic syringe model accurately describes how people are influenced by the media.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Rather than promoting social order, religion is a source of conflict in society.’ Evaluate this view.
OR
‘There is little evidence to support the secularisation thesis.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
